card.name: Hyphen in ZIP+4 codes and URLs
card.fires_on: The hyphen joining a five-digit US ZIP code to its four-digit extension in mailing addresses. Also hyphens inside web addresses and a few web-page phrases.

modes.label: ZIP+4 hyphen
modes.description: The hyphen between a five-digit ZIP code and the four-digit add-on at the end of a US address.

modes.description: A hyphenated part inside a web address or domain name.

modes.label: Web page wording
modes.description: Words in website navigation or page-footer text, such as home page or accessed.
